overview: An open, reconfigurable SSTR bench for adapting spot size, optical access, and sample mounting. It is suited to method development and samples that need non-standard fixtures.
overviewZh: 开放式、可重构的 SSTR 光学平台，可灵活调整光斑、光学通道与样品夹具，适合方法开发以及需要特殊装夹的样品。
principle: A continuous-wave pump, or modulation slow enough for quasi-steady heating, raises the transducer temperature. The probe measures thermoreflectance versus absorbed pump power. Calibration and a steady heat-flow model yield thermal conductivity; interface sensitivity depends on the layer structure and beam size.
principleZh: 连续泵浦光或足够慢的调制加热，使金属传感层达到近稳态温升。探测光测量热反射响应随吸收泵浦功率的变化；通过标定与稳态传热模型提取热导率。界面参数的可辨识性取决于膜层结构与光斑尺寸。
